label: REAL
summary: macOS and Windows become real install targets: official unsigned portable archives, native data locations, product-owned SHA-256, platform doctor check, and a fresh-user acceptance sequence run against the extracted artifact on all three operating systems.
semver_rationale: Additive: new official artifacts and one new doctor check; API v1, --json shapes, server.json and Linux data locations unchanged. Minor release.

linux_vulkan.note: maintainer's machine, one integrated + one discrete GPU

macos_metal.note: paravirtualized Metal device; function not performance

windows_cpu.note: extracted ZIP acceptance + Task Scheduler lifecycle on windows-latest

official_linux_amd64_deb.note: membrane_1.2.0_amd64.deb + membrane-cpu, built by scripts/build-release.sh from the tagged commit; extracted .deb passed package-acceptance in CI

windows_package.note: built by scripts/package-portable.py in the windows-support-smoke CI job from the release commit

macos_package.note: built by scripts/package-portable.py in the macos-metal-smoke CI job from the release commit

real_upgrade_test.label: REAL
real_upgrade_test.result: A copy of the maintainer's real v1.1.0 registry and server.json were left byte-IDENTICAL after 14 read-only commands (status screen, doctor, models, models available, models recommend, plan, observe, advise, apply without --yes, adaptive status, run --explain, model list, status, --version); no state/audit directory was created, and the platform-native path rule still resolved the existing Linux directories. Done with a cmake-install of the merged code (before the version-string bump), not the .deb; `apply` exited 4 because no server was running, so there was nothing to apply.

host_memory.note: already native since v1.0.0; documentation corrected

bugs_found_by_running_real_packages: Windows mkdir of drive-rooted paths ('C:') failed with EACCES
installed macOS membrane used $ORIGIN rpath, which dyld ignores
Windows ZIP lacked curl/zlib DLLs (fixed with vcpkg applocal deps install)

security.note: acceptance asserts no Access-Control-Allow-Origin header on every OS

known_limitations: macOS and Windows archives are unsigned and not notarized; Gatekeeper/SmartScreen warn
real-hardware validation exists only for Linux; macOS and Windows are hosted-CI validated
Windows GPU backends (CUDA, Vulkan) are not validated and not shipped; the ZIP is a CPU build
macOS Metal evidence is a paravirtualized device: functional, not performance
no Intel-Mac, Windows-on-Arm, installer-format or package-manager artifacts
adaptive pressure behavior is validated by a synthetic timeline, not induced hardware pressure
Ollama and vLLM were tested against mock servers, not live daemons
no multi-GPU execution or distributed orchestration
CXL and FPGA remain research only
